provenance.numericPolicy: All supplied Weather numeric/null/nested values preserved exactly; no clamping or workload reduction
provenance.labelPolicy: Only status/source/cloudSource/cloudWindSource replaced with explicit recorded QA fallback labels

mapping.selection: Pending original jobs first, then submitted-frame, then completed history; bounded candidate links and one bounded mesh scan

lifetime.scope: Original scoped calls only; shared owner/link budgets with terminal map. Unknown contexts are not absent owners. Effect/context IDs local to lifetime. No strong Effect/resource retention, new Promise/await/GPU/readiness calls, source/defines exports or frame snapshots.

shaderAttribution.scope: Observed original validated shader Promise jobs only. IDs are local technical identities. Terminal mapping reads current data slots; last cached batches are not new visibility/readiness evaluation. Missing earlier/retired modules stay unobserved. No shader text/defines/GPU objects, new getCompilationInfo/render/await or whole-scene dump.

compilation.timingScope: Inclusive CPU API calls (nested scopes overlap); async durations are completion latency, not GPU execution time

sharedCacheCounters.scope: Babylon static counters shared by all engines in this JavaScript realm

shaderInventory.source: Existing compilationProfile inventory; scalar projection without shader text or define names

scope: 1Hz technical startup observer only; stopped before gameplay measurement. Existing production compilation/health hooks unchanged.
